name: Allcargo Terminals Limited
summary: Allcargo Terminals Limited operates container freight stations (CFS) and logistics business in India and internationally. It provides import and export handling; bonded, non-bonded, and open warehousing; direct port delivery; hazardous cargo; cargo handling; reefer container; ISO tank; and mile delivery services. Allcargo Terminals Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
